'''Anesthetic gas''' was a gas capable of rendering [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] unconscious.

[[MD-2 medical droid]]s were experts in administering anesthetic gasses and were knowledgable about the how [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] reacted to it.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
